sqlMap.select: SELECT T.ID, T.TITLE, T.CONTENT, T.PARENT_ID, (SELECT TITLE FROM ev_group WHERE t.PARENT_ID=ID) PNAME, T.DEPTH, T.ACTIVITY, T.CREATE_DATE, GET_EMP_LOCAL_NAME(T.CREATE_BY) CREATE_BY, T.ORDERNO FROM EV_GROUP T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH T.DEPTH = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR T.ID = T.PARENT_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.ORDERNO
SELECT T.ID, T.TITLE, T.CONTENT, T.PARENT_ID, (SELECT TITLE FROM EV_GROUP WHERE T.PARENT_ID = ID) PNAME, T.DEPTH, T.ORDERNO FROM EV_GROUP T WHERE T.ID = #ID#
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO EV_GROUP (ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CPNY_ID, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, ORDERNO, PARENT_ID, DEPTH) VALUES (EV_EMP_GROUP_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #TITLE#, #CONTENT#, #interCpnyID#, 1, SYSDATE, #CREATE_BY#, #ORDERNO#, #PARENT_ID:NUMERIC#, #DEPTH:NUMERIC#)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EV_GROUP T SET T.TITLE = #TITLE#, T.CONTENT = #CONTENT#, T.UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, T.UPDATE_BY = #UPDATE_BY#, T.PARENT_ID = #PARENT_ID:NUMERIC#, T.DEPTH = #DEPTH:NUMERIC#, T.ORDERNO = #ORDERNO# WHERE T.ID = #ID#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM EV_GROUP T WHERE T.ID = #ID#
